mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a monetary tightening cycle compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 7.5% signals labor market strengthening, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE threshold is not crossed in the subsequent period, or 5-day returns do not significantly outperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) combined with elevated GDPC1 (demand growth) creates conflicting signals, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS-GDPC1 combination occurs but 60-day returns are not negative, or the interaction effect's IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% signals sustainable momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not increase below 2.0% in the late-cycle expansion regime, or 20-day returns fail to follow the predicted positive trend (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the INDPRO supply index above 98 indicates robust production growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 98 but 20-day returns are not significantly positive, or the effect is reversed in subsequent periods (IC < 0.03 over 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt increase in labor participation (PAYEMS) above 133,000 signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not cross above 133,000 in the next period, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong simultaneous growth in both demand (GDPC1) and business activity (RSAFS) above critical thresholds signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS both exceed thresholds but 60-day returns are not positive, or the interaction effect's IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sharp rise in the INDPRO supply index above 100 indicates renewed production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross above 100 in the post-shock recovery regime, or 20-day returns fail to follow the positive trend (p > 0.05).
